_doc: The enemy spider's sounds (Creatures/SpiderSystem): element -> variants; a variant is a list of layers summed. A file layer: src (relative to the Drive's Raw\Audio folder, the parent of TARTARUS_AUDIO_SRC), t (cut start s, snapped to the onset at or after it), dur (s), at (placement in the output s, default 0), db (default 0), pitch (semitones, default 0), hp / lp (Hz). A noise layer (a hiss, synthesised): noise (s), band [lo, hi] Hz, attack / release (s), tremolo (Hz, the rattle in it; 0 none), db. Outputs Creatures/spider/<element>_<n>.wav, mono 48 kHz, key snd.foley.spider.<element> (it mixes as NPC foley), levelled to target_lufs_m per element. Credits: Raw\Audio\audio-src\spider\CREDITS.md and the packs' own licences.
